testcase.name: close reentry selects a live replacement before obsolete transport results finish()
remote connection returned before its first stream survives duplicate settlement()
remote retention remains usable when the peer has no selection protocol()
mplex remote connection returned before its first stream survives duplicate settlement()
concurrent published reusers survive cancellation of all original callers()
concurrent published reusers survive cancellation of one original caller()
stream opened directly on an inbound callback parent survives duplicate settlement()
